questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Agatha Christie and her detective Poirot
How to win at the board game Cluedo every time
The history of train travel across Europe
Why crime stories are popular on television
questions.why: The programme is about Agatha Christie, especially 'Murder on the Orient Express' and Hercule Poirot.

questions.q: What does Neil say about the last time he played Cluedo?
options: He has never played the game before
He found the game much too difficult
It was Professor Plum in the library
He was the murderer in the game
questions.why: Neil says, 'it was Professor Plum, in the library, with the dagger!'

questions.q: How many copies of Agatha Christie's crime novels have been sold?
options: About 103 million
Over 2 billion
Around 33 million
Just under 1 billion
questions.why: Sam says over 2 billion copies have been sold, making her the best-selling novelist of all time.

questions.q: Why must the killer on the Orient Express be one of the passengers?
options: The police saw the murderer get on the train
Poirot saw the crime happen through a window
The victim wrote the killer's name before dying
Nobody could leave the snow-trapped train unseen
questions.why: Harriet Gilbert says nobody could reach or escape the snow-trapped train without leaving footprints.

questions.q: Why is Poirot perplexed at first?
options: Nobody will answer his questions
The train is too crowded to search
Each passenger seems to have an alibi
He cannot find the murder weapon
questions.why: Harriet says as he investigates, it seems that each of them has an alibi for the time of the murder.

questions.q: Why doesn't Sam say what happens at the end of the story?
options: She doesn't want to spoil it for listeners
She has not finished reading the book
She can't remember who the killer was
The ending is different in every version
questions.why: Sam says, 'I won't spoil the story by telling you what happens next.'

options: Agatha Christie's only daughter
An actress who played Miss Marple
A presenter of World Book Club
An author of new Poirot stories
questions.why: Sam says she has written several new Poirot stories based on Agatha Christie's characters.

questions.q: Which of Poirot's habits does Sophie Hannah describe?
options: He is often rude to the people he questions
He likes neatness and order
He is always late and very untidy
He hates travelling by train
questions.why: She says he likes neatness and order, works methodically, and is proud of his moustaches.
